title: Manipur Police Intensify Crackdown on Illicit Liquor; Over 2,500 Litres Seized in Imphal East and Senapati
summary: Manipur Police seized illicit liquor in Imphal East and Senapati during special drives, while the DGP reviewed the suspected spurious liquor investigation at Sugnu Police Station.
body:
Imphal, November 22, 2026: Manipur Police have intensified their drive against illicit liquor across several districts, with large quantities of locally brewed and other alcoholic beverages seized during raids in Imphal East and Senapati. Meanwhile, the Director General of Police (DGP), Manipur, reviewed the investigation into the suspected spurious liquor incident during a visit to Sugnu Police Station on Sunday.

**2,130 Litres Seized in Imphal East**

On November 21, police stations across Imphal East District conducted raids as part of a special drive against illicit liquor, including joint operations at local breweries.

According to the district police, a total of 2,130.875 litres of liquor was seized during the operation. The seized stock included 1,683.500 litres of DIC liquor, 351.375 litres of Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) and 96 litres of beer.

Police stated that the special drive would continue across the district as part of efforts to curb the production, storage and sale of illicit liquor.

**Senapati Police Conduct Joint Drives with Excise Department**

Senapati District Police also carried out a series of operations against illicit liquor between November 17 and 21, 2026.

The drive conducted on November 21 was carried out jointly with the Excise Department in Senapati district headquarters and Maram Bazar.

During the operations, authorities seized 380 litres of DIC liquor, 12 bottles and 11 half-bottles of IMFL, along with 48 bottles and 61 cans of beer and Breezer.

The seized liquor was handed over to the concerned Excise Department for necessary action.

**DGP Reviews Suspected Spurious Liquor Investigation**

Separately, on November 22, the Director General of Police, Manipur, visited Sugnu Police Station to review the investigation into the suspected spurious liquor incident. He was accompanied by the Superintendent of Police, Kakching District.

Members of the Special Investigation Team (SIT) and the Investigating Officer from Chakpikarong Police Station attended the review meeting.

During the visit, the DGP assessed the situation and reviewed the progress of investigations and action taken so far in cases being investigated at Sugnu and Chakpikarong Police Stations.

He issued directions to the Investigating Officers regarding further investigative steps and areas requiring verification, while stressing the importance of adhering to legal and procedural safeguards.

The continuing raids and the review of the suspected spurious liquor cases come amid heightened enforcement against illicit liquor in Manipur. Police and Excise authorities are continuing their operations, while investigations into the liquor-related deaths remain underway.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
